text: Mo bìnú gan; wọn ṣe aṣiṣe lẹ́ẹkansi! 😡
Abincin nan ya ɓaci; na ji ƙyama, ba zan ci ba 🤢.
Anyị tụrụ ụjọ n’abalị mgbe ọkụ gwụchara; obi tetara m ọsọ ọsọ.
rationale: Cues: ‘tụrụ ụjọ’ (felt fear) → fear; night power-out amplifies threat.

text: So happy right now—I passed the interview! 🎉
rationale: Cues: ‘happy’ and ‘passed the interview’ → joy; ‘🎉’ → joy.

text: Feeling really down today; missed the deadline and nothing seems to work.
rationale: Cues: ‘feeling really down’ and failure context → sadness.

text: Ó yà mí lẹ́nu! Ṣe bẹẹ ni? 😮
rationale: Cues: ‘Ó yà mí lẹ́nu’ (it surprised me) → surprise; ‘😮’ → surprise.

text: I just opened the email—OMG I actually won the placement! 😲🎉
Na firgita sosai kuma na shiga ɓacin rai lokacin da suka yi min ha’inci.
rationale: Cues: ‘firgita sosai’ (very scared) → fear; ‘ɓacin rai’ (anger) → anger; betrayal context.

text: Ọ na-esi ísì ọjọọ; obi dị m nwute, anaghị m eri ya.
rationale: Cues: ‘ísi ọjọọ’ (bad smell) → disgust; ‘obi dị m nwute’ (I am sad) → sadness.
